source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Virtus_mask "When using combat spells from Ancient Magicks, the magic damage bonus is increased to 5% for each piece for a total of 15%." Three points per piece over and above the 2% each piece's stat line already carries; standard spells and powered staves get the stat and nothing more. Pooled rather than taken as its own floored multiplier, which would overstate the effect once the pool is large.
